design: Round 1: paired effects/examples/guidance on 20 reused scenes, matched observations and flow. At most one revised round allowed. Select least-assisted variant reaching >=18/20, order effects then examples then guidance; this ordering is a design choice, not a measured scalar of teaching. If none pass after round 2, stop/report. Selected variant frozen before 40 fresh heldout unique observed scenes. Whole selection/intention/action scored against offline all-target labels. Must choose unfinished target unless all four middle edges solved. All align/insert/extract/done families must occur among heldout choices, >=36/40 overall. Four middle-complete scenes test leaving solved pieces alone. All eight non-bottom edges shown only for target selection; local subcases can repeat. Then ten noncomplete integration starts, >=9/10 required. Exclude development states/scenes from later phases. Targets and all tactics chosen by JEV.
